'''Firebugs''' were [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. [[T'Charek Haathi]] believed that [[Dren Nord]] would rather eat live firebugs than execute her operation to steal the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']] from a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Zelos II]].<ref name="Ship Jackers">{{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref>
